Features.Title: Record Shift Drop in one small window
Features.Description: Enter the batch, cash drop, payout and reason. Press Enter or OK to save for your selected store.

Features.Title: Missing batches are retrieved in the background
Features.Description: Your entry waits safely while the matching store’s Z report is retrieved. See Pending Shift Drops.

Features.Title: See OVER, SHORT or BALANCED immediately
Features.Description: After the report is available, overages show in green and shortages in red.

Features.Title: Shift payouts flow into Cash & Sales Summary
Features.Description: Payouts and reasons transfer by store and date. Separate summary payouts stay available for owner review.

Features.Title: Choose Light, Dark or Follow Windows
Features.Description: Find your theme under Settings → Appearance. Your preference is remembered.

Features.Title: Close a month and review its history
Features.Description: Use Settings → Month Close / History. Review closed records through Period → Previous Month or Custom.

Features.Title: Start each month with opening cash
Features.Description: Enter monthly opening cash in Cash On Hand. New drops and payouts update it without counting the old balance twice.
